n_b4fd0cf9bc: Fix: A rewarded ad that fails before the VPN connects is tried again once the VPN is up, where the connect stopped at the first failure
n_8d0093a58f: Fix: When the server does not accept the ad you watched, the app tells you so and asks for no second one
n_28c9e42712: Fix: When the VPN stops answering the app, the app shows it stopped within seconds, where its status froze and Disconnect did nothing
n_5d6af983d3: Fix: Switching servers while the VPN is still connecting no longer stops or replaces the new connection, where the old connect could end it, by failing or by finishing late
n_c459ae5a14: Update: The app takes an access key's updates only from a secure (https) link, where a plain http link could bring an update from anyone on the way, which could send you to their server
n_cc4c56781b: Fix: On a device set to Turkish, server locations whose code has an "i", as Iran or Italy, show and connect right
n_7d425ad619: Fix: When a connect fails before the VPN opens, iPhone and Apple TV hear of it at once, where they kept waiting
n_154695a28c: Fix: Stopping the VPN as it starts stops it, where it could come up after, or keep iPhone and Apple TV waiting
n_1ac6a06ab4: Improve: With a list of proxies, the app connects as soon as one of them reaches your server, and checks the rest in the background, where it checked the whole list first
n_b1a3dd1013: Fix: When none of your proxies works, the app says so, where a proxy that was turned off or never tried, or one that refused its user name and password, made it blame the server; when your server is down behind proxies that work, the app says the server cannot be reached
n_5cbdae7203: Fix: With Split Domains on, DNS lookups no longer stall: about half of them were held back, and an app waited for its own retry
n_86885b7406: Fix: With Split Domains on, an app whose server speaks first, as with SMTP, FTP or MySQL, connects after a second, where it waited until it gave up
n_467a8f37bf: Update: Split Domains takes no `*`: `example.com` covers the domain and all its subdomains, as `*.example.com` did, and a `*` anywhere else, as `*ads.example.com`, never matched anything. A list with one is refused when you save it, and the app says which entry. A list saved before loses the `*.` at the start of its entries, which changes nothing
n_d185a39161: Update: In Split Domains, the most specific domain wins, so you can make exceptions: with `google.com` excluded and `mail.google.com` included, mail goes through the VPN and the rest of Google around it, and a site under a blocked domain can be excluded or included. Block > Exclude > Include decides only for the same domain
n_a559814851: Improve: When a split list refuses an entry, the app says why in your language and names the entry; an IP list no longer refuses a comment line that starts with spaces
n_df6cef4564: Improve: When an ad fails, or the server's address cannot be found, the app says so in your language, where it showed a technical message in English
n_0297a28dd6: Update: The app has a new icon, its name on a ribbon across the top
n_fd437d9c81: Improve: On Remote Access, you can paste into every box, IP and proxy lists included, a password manager can fill in your sign-in, and any character you type shows
n_12e5156485: Fix: The VPN no longer stays on Waiting after your device moves to a network that cannot reach the server's address, such as a Wi-Fi without IPv6 after mobile data: it connects again by itself within about a minute
